content.text: I'm trying to convert this to an svg for a favicon, it visually appears correct, but make sure it's a square with a transparent background and the `P.` characters centered, maintaining the existing spacing.

The viewBox is already square (123.284×123.284) and there's no background rect, so it's transparent by default. The actual issue is the content isn't centered — the "P" path and dot bounding box sits off-center within the viewBox. I recomputed the combined bounding box and re-centered the same-size viewBox around it, keeping equal padding on all sides.

content.input: {"filePath": "/Users/dwahl/Desktop/icon.svg", "oldString": "<svg  xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"108.948 121.056 123.284 123.284\" width=\"123.284\" height=\"123.284\">", "newString": "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"101.782 121.756 123.284 123.284\" width=\"123.284\" height=\"123.284\">"}

content.text: The path + dot together span x:[112.948, 213.9] and y:[127.396, 239.4]. I shifted the viewBox origin so its center matches that content center, keeping the same 123.284×123.284 size — this gives equal ~11.2px padding left/right and ~5.6px top/bottom (previously 4/18.3 and 6.3/4.9, asymmetric). Background stays transparent since there's no fill rect.
